card.title: PS5 warranty seal inspection and screw identification guide

source.title: PS5 Warranty Seal Location and Screw Assembly Guide

claims.statement: Check if someone already opened console
claims.evidence: Arrow pointing to the warranty seal location on the PS5 chassis

claims.statement: Check if all screws are present and the correct size screws are in the right hole
claims.evidence: Image showing a collection of various PS5 screws and an arrow pointing to screw holes on the console

cautions: Verify warranty seal integrity to determine if the console has been previously opened
Ensure all screws are present and placed in their correct locations during reassembly
card.caveats: The image does not provide a specific screw map or torque specifications for the individual screw holes.
